fire.prompt: Arcade submarine torpedo launch: sharp pneumatic thump and hiss followed by a quick underwater whoosh moving away. Punchy, clean, no music.

splash.prompt: A single small shell plunging into the ocean: short sharp water splash with a brief bubbly fizz. Clean game sound effect, no music.

explosion.prompt: Arcade naval direct hit: punchy explosion on a metal warship hull, deep boom with a metallic clang and a short crackling debris tail. Game sound effect, no music.

sink.prompt: A warship sinking after a final explosion: big deep boom, then groaning twisting metal and rushing water with bubbles fading out. Cinematic game sound effect, no music.

your-turn.prompt: Single clean submarine sonar ping, bright high tone with a long echoing underwater reverb tail. Clear and iconic.

clock-tick.prompt: Single short tense electronic countdown beep, crisp high-pitched blip, dry, no reverb.

match-found.prompt: Retro arcade radar contact alert: two quick rising electronic blips then a bright confirmation tone. Exciting and clean.

victory.prompt: Short triumphant arcade victory fanfare: bright synth brass and rising notes, naval adventure feel, ending on a strong major chord.

defeat.prompt: Short arcade game-over sting: descending sad synth notes ending on a low tone, with a few sinking bubbles.

ui-place.prompt: Short heavy metallic clunk of a game piece locking onto a steel board, tight and satisfying, dry.

ui-rotate.prompt: Very short mechanical servo whirr turning a part, crisp game UI sound.

ui-randomize.prompt: Quick shuffle of metal game pieces sliding and clattering, then settling with a click. Short game UI sound.

ui-ready.prompt: Submarine control console confirmation: hydraulic lock engaging with a hiss, followed by a bright two-note chime. Short game UI sound.

ambient-hum.prompt: Seamless submarine interior ambience: low steady engine hum, soft distant hull creaks and gentle water pressure, calm and deep. No music.

ambient-ping.prompt: Very distant, faint submarine sonar ping echoing deep underwater, soft and muffled.
